I currently have just one monitor, BenQ XL2720T, and I've been thinking of getting a second. Currently running an ASUS GTX 980 Strix which can support 4k.

Can you recommend a great (g-sync?) monitor for around $600?

My second question, is it worth waiting for a 4k 120/144hz monitor instead?

A single 980 won't be able to run AAA games at 4K 120/144 fps without knocking down the graphical quality pretty low, which severely reduces the need for 4K. I suggest looking for a 1440p g-sync monitor to get a nice balance between resolution, graphical quality and refresh rate. This is a bit above your budget, but it's the best I could come up with.
